about_intro: Ethio Domestic Workers Link (EDWL) is a digital platform created to connect domestic workers and employers across Ethiopia in a safe, transparent, and respectful way.
about_goal: Our goal is to simplify the process of finding and offering domestic work by using technology to bridge gaps, reduce misinformation, and promote dignity in domestic employment.
what_we_do_intro: EDWL serves as a job-matching and information platform where:
what_we_do_1: Domestic workers can create profiles, showcase their skills, and search for job opportunities.
what_we_do_2: Employers can post domestic job vacancies and connect with suitable candidates.
what_we_do_3: Both parties can interact more transparently and efficiently.
our_purpose_intro: Domestic work plays a vital role in many Ethiopian households, yet access to reliable job information has often been informal and unsafe. EDWL was created to:

privacy_hero_desc: At EDWL, your privacy is a fundamental right. This policy explains clearly how we collect, protect, and use your personal information.
privacy_1_content: We collect information you voluntarily provide when registering, including your full name, gender, phone number, email address, profile photo, national ID documents (for verification), and employment history. For employers, we also collect business type and family size. We do not collect biometric data beyond the voluntary Fayda ID verification process.
privacy_2_content: Your information is used to: match workers with suitable employers using our AI engine; verify identity via Fayda ID and police/health clearance; process payments through Chapa, Telebirr, and Stripe; send status notifications via Telegram; and comply with Ethiopian labor law. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to any third party.
privacy_3_content: All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3. Sensitive documents (National ID, health certificates) are stored in our encrypted Biometric Vault, accessible only to Platinum-tier verified employers. Passwords are hashed using bcrypt with 10 salt rounds. We use JWT tokens with expiry for all authenticated sessions. Access logs are maintained for all sensitive operations.
privacy_4_content: Payment transactions are processed by third-party providers (Chapa, Telebirr, Stripe) under their respective privacy policies. EDWL stores only transaction references and status for reconciliation and audit purposes. We never store raw card or mobile-money credentials on our servers.
privacy_5_content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. You may request data export or account deletion by contacting support@edwl.com. Verified workers may request removal of their National ID from the vault. Employers may request deletion of their hiring history.
privacy_6_content: EDWL serves diaspora employers in the USA, EU, UAE, and other regions. When data is processed internationally (e.g., via Stripe), it is subject to GDPR-standard data transfer agreements. Ethiopian user data is primarily stored on servers within the EU (Supabase PostgreSQL) under standard contractual clauses.
privacy_contact_desc: Our Data Protection Officer is available Monday–Saturday to address any concerns.
